responsibility: This definition module declares the file-output interface for `DynamicStrings.String` values. It belongs to the gm2 text I/O convenience layer and exports `Write` and `WriteLn` for sending managed strings to an `FIO.File`, providing the string-based counterpart to the simpler `CHAR` and `ARRAYOFCHAR` output modules.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the String pair: it declares output procedures for `DynamicStrings.String`, while `gcc/m2/gm2-libs/String.mod` contains the character-by-character emission logic built on the `CHAR` module.
